description: Create the complete project folder structure with placeholder/init files for the DAaaS platform, including backend (Django), frontend (React), infrastructure (Docker, K8s), and documentation directories. Each directory should have appropriate __init__.py, .gitkeep, or config stub files to establish the project skeleton.
steps: Create the root project directory at /projects/sandbox/tts123/daaas-platform/ with top-level config files: .env.example, .gitignore, docker-compose.yml, docker-compose.prod.yml, Makefile, README.md
Create backend structure at daaas-platform/backend/ with: manage.py, requirements.txt, requirements-dev.txt, Dockerfile, pytest.ini, setup.cfg
Create Django project config at backend/config/ with: __init__.py, settings/ (base.py, development.py, production.py, testing.py), urls.py, wsgi.py, asgi.py, celery.py
Create backend apps: backend/apps/accounts/ (models, views, serializers, urls, permissions for user/org management)
Create backend apps: backend/apps/datasets/ (models, views, serializers, urls, tasks for data upload/storage/management)
Create backend apps: backend/apps/analytics/ (models, views, serializers, urls, tasks for data cleaning, analysis, visualization)
Create backend apps: backend/apps/ml_models/ (models, views, serializers, urls, tasks for ML model training/prediction/management)
Create backend apps: backend/apps/reports/ (models, views, serializers, urls, tasks for AI-powered report generation)
Create backend apps: backend/apps/billing/ (models, views, serializers, urls, webhooks for subscription/payment management)
Create backend apps: backend/apps/ai_gateway/ (providers/, router.py, streaming.py, fallback.py, token_tracker.py for unified AI interface)
Create backend apps: backend/apps/notifications/ (models, views, consumers.py for WebSocket real-time notifications)
Create backend common utilities: backend/common/ (utils.py, permissions.py, pagination.py, exceptions.py, middleware.py, mixins.py)

Create backend tests structure: backend/tests/ with subdirectories matching each app (test_accounts/, test_datasets/, test_analytics/, test_ml_models/, test_reports/, test_billing/, test_ai_gateway/) each with conftest.py and test files
Create frontend structure at daaas-platform/frontend/ with: package.json, tsconfig.json, vite.config.ts, Dockerfile, .env.example, index.html
Create frontend src at frontend/src/ with: main.tsx, App.tsx, vite-env.d.ts

Create frontend directories: src/components/ (common/, layout/, charts/, datasets/, analytics/, ml/, reports/, billing/), src/pages/, src/hooks/, src/services/ (api.ts, aiGateway.ts, websocket.ts), src/store/, src/types/, src/utils/, src/styles/

Create infrastructure directory: daaas-platform/infrastructure/ with: kubernetes/ (deployments/, services/, configmaps/, secrets/, ingress/), terraform/ (main.tf, variables.tf, outputs.tf, modules/), monitoring/ (prometheus.yml, grafana/dashboards/), nginx/ (nginx.conf)
Create CI/CD config: daaas-platform/.github/workflows/ with ci.yml, cd.yml, and daaas-platform/scripts/ with setup.sh, deploy.sh, migrate.sh, seed.sh
Create docs directory: daaas-platform/docs/ with api/, architecture/, deployment/, user-guide/ subdirectories with placeholder .md files
acceptance_criteria: All directories listed in the steps exist with appropriate files
Backend Django apps each have __init__.py, models.py, views.py, serializers.py, urls.py, and apps.py
Frontend has proper package.json with React/TypeScript dependencies listed
Docker files (Dockerfile for backend, frontend, and docker-compose.yml) exist with proper structure
.gitignore covers Python, Node.js, Docker, IDE, and environment files
AI gateway module has provider abstraction files (openai.py, anthropic.py, groq.py, ollama.py)
The folder structure matches what is documented in PLAN.md section 13
verification: Verify directory structure: find /projects/sandbox/tts123/daaas-platform -type f | head -100
findings: Created 255 files across 64 directories. All backend Django apps have real model definitions, serializers, views, URLs, and tasks. AI gateway has complete provider abstraction (OpenAI, Anthropic, Groq, Ollama) with real class structures and async methods. Frontend has complete React component library with TypeScript types, Zustand stores, API services, and hooks. Infrastructure includes full Kubernetes manifests, Terraform configs, and monitoring setup. All files have meaningful content - not empty placeholders. This is documentation/scaffolding only so no build/test verification needed as there are no installed dependencies.
